  <script>
    const canvas = document.getElementById('waveCanvas');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    const dbEl = document.getElementById('db');
    const audioEl = document.getElementById('audioPlayer');

    let audioContext, analyser, source;
    let isAudioContextReady = false;

    const bufferLength = 2048;
    const dataArray = new Uint8Array(bufferLength);

    const AVG_FRAME = 60;
    let dbHistory = [];

    audioEl.onplay = async () => {
      if (!isAudioContextReady) {
        audioContext = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        analyser = audioContext.createAnalyser();
        analyser.fftSize = bufferLength;
        analyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.8;

        source = audioContext.createMediaElementSource(audioEl);
        source.connect(analyser);
        analyser.connect(audioContext.destination);
        isAudioContextReady = true;
      }
      loop();
    };

    function loop() {
      if (audioEl.paused) return;

      // 1. 计算 RMS 分贝
      analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(dataArray);
      let sumSq = 0;
      for (let v of dataArray) {
        const n = (v / 128.0) - 1.0;
        sumSq += n * n;
      }
      const rms = Math.sqrt(sumSq / bufferLength);
      let instantDb = 20 * Math.log10(Math.max(rms, 0.00001));

      dbHistory.push(instantDb);
      if (dbHistory.length > AVG_FRAME) dbHistory.shift();
      const avgDb = dbHistory.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) / dbHistory.length;

      dbEl.textContent = avgDb.toFixed(1);
      dbEl.classList.toggle('warn', avgDb > -20);

      // 2. 绘制实心连贯的能量图
      ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

      ctx.beginPath();
      const sliceWidth = canvas.width / bufferLength;
      let x = 0;

      // 绘制上边缘的波形
      for (let i = 0; i < bufferLength; i++) {
        const v = dataArray[i] / 128.0;
        const y = (v * canvas.height) / 2;

        if (i === 0) {
          ctx.moveTo(x, y);
        } else {
          ctx.lineTo(x, y);
        }
        x += sliceWidth;
      }

      // --- 核心修改：将图形封闭并填充 ---
      // 连线到右下角 -> 左下角 -> 起点（形成闭合路径）
      ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, canvas.height);
      ctx.lineTo(0, canvas.height);
      ctx.closePath();

      // 使用填充颜色（类似图片中的亮蓝色）
      ctx.fillStyle = '#00b4ff';
      ctx.fill(); // 执行填充

      requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }
  </script>
</body>

</html>

<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>频谱柱状图</title>
  <title>它拿到的是经过 FFT（快速傅里叶变换）计算后的结果（频域数据）</title>
  <style>
    #db {
      font-size: 20px;
      margin: 10px 0;
      display: inline-block;
    }

    .warn {
      color: #f44;
    }

    }

    .audio-content {
      margin-top: 20px;

      gap: 10px;
    }
  </style>
</head>

<body>
  <!-- 只保留一个 Canvas -->
  <canvas id="barCanvas" width="600" height="200"></canvas>

  <div class="audio-content">
    <audio id="audioPlayer" controls src="./audio/01.mp3"></audio>
    <div>当前分贝：<span id="db">0</span> dB</div>
  </div>

  <script>
    const barCanvas = document.getElementById('barCanvas');
    const barCtx = barCanvas.getContext('2d');
    const dbEl = document.getElementById('db');
    const audioEl = document.getElementById('audioPlayer');

    let audioContext, analyser, source;
    let isAudioContextReady = false;

    const bufferLength = 2048;
    const fftBinCount = 1024;
    const dataArray = new Uint8Array(fftBinCount);

    const AVG_FRAME = 60;
    let dbHistory = [];
    const BAR_COUNT = 64; // 柱状图数量

    audioEl.onplay = async () => {
      if (!isAudioContextReady) {
        audioContext = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        analyser = audioContext.createAnalyser();
        analyser.fftSize = bufferLength;
        analyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.8;

        source = audioContext.createMediaElementSource(audioEl);
        source.connect(analyser);
        analyser.connect(audioContext.destination);
        isAudioContextReady = true;
      }
      loop();
    };

    function loop() {
      if (audioEl.paused) return;

      // 1. 计算 RMS 分贝
      analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(dataArray);
      let sumSq = 0;
      for (let v of dataArray) {
        const n = (v / 128.0) - 1.0;
        sumSq += n * n;
      }
      const rms = Math.sqrt(sumSq / bufferLength);
      let instantDb = 20 * Math.log10(Math.max(rms, 0.00001));

      dbHistory.push(instantDb);
      if (dbHistory.length > AVG_FRAME) dbHistory.shift();
      const avgDb = dbHistory.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) / dbHistory.length;

      dbEl.textContent = avgDb.toFixed(1);
      dbEl.classList.toggle('warn', avgDb > -20);

      // 2. 获取频域数据
      analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);

      // 3. 绘制柱状图
      // 清空画布
      barCtx.fillStyle = '#000';
      barCtx.fillRect(0, 0, barCanvas.width, barCanvas.height);

      const barWidth = barCanvas.width / BAR_COUNT;
      const step = Math.floor(fftBinCount / BAR_COUNT);

      for (let i = 0; i < BAR_COUNT; i++) {
        // 取每个区间的平均值
        let sum = 0;
        for (let j = 0; j < step; j++) {
          sum += dataArray[i * step + j];
        }
        const avgVal = sum / step;
        const barHeight = (avgVal / 255) * barCanvas.height;

        // 渐变色：低频绿 -> 高频红
        const hue = 120 - (i / BAR_COUNT) * 120;
        barCtx.fillStyle = `hsl(${hue}, 100%, 50%)`;

        // 绘制柱子
        const x = i * barWidth;
        const y = barCanvas.height - barHeight;
        barCtx.fillRect(x, y, barWidth - 1, barHeight);
      }

      requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }
  </script>
</body>

</html>

    let dbHistory = [];

    // 【核心修改】将柱子数量直接设为 Canvas 的宽度（600）
    // 这样每个柱子刚好占 1 像素，完美铺满画布
    const BAR_COUNT = barCanvas.width;

    audioEl.onplay = async () => {
      if (!isAudioContextReady) {
        audioContext = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();

        analyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.8;

        source = audioContext.createMediaElementSource(audioEl);
        source.connect(analyser);
        analyser.connect(audioContext.destination);
        isAudioContextReady = true;
      }
      loop();
    };

    function loop() {
      if (audioEl.paused) return;

      // 1. 计算 RMS 分贝
      analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(dataArray);
      let sumSq = 0;
      for (let v of dataArray) {
        const n = (v / 128.0) - 1.0;
        sumSq += n * n;
      }
      const rms = Math.sqrt(sumSq / bufferLength);
      let instantDb = 20 * Math.log10(Math.max(rms, 0.00001));

      dbHistory.push(instantDb);
      if (dbHistory.length > AVG_FRAME) dbHistory.shift();
      const avgDb = dbHistory.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) / dbHistory.length;

      dbEl.textContent = avgDb.toFixed(1);
      dbEl.classList.toggle('warn', avgDb > -20);

      // 2. 获取频域数据
      analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);

      // 3. 绘制无缝极细柱状图
      barCtx.fillStyle = '#000';
      barCtx.fillRect(0, 0, barCanvas.width, barCanvas.height);

      // 每个柱子的宽度固定为 1 像素
      const barWidth = 1;
      // 计算每个 1px 柱子对应多少个 FFT 频点
      const step = fftBinCount / BAR_COUNT;

      for (let i = 0; i < BAR_COUNT; i++) {
        // 获取对应频点的值（这里直接取整索引，保证每个像素都有数据）
        const val = dataArray[Math.floor(i * step)];
        const barHeight = (val / 255) * barCanvas.height;

        // 渐变色：低频绿 -> 高频红
        const hue = 120 - (i / BAR_COUNT) * 120;
        barCtx.fillStyle = `hsl(${hue}, 100%, 50%)`;

        // 【核心修改】绘制 1px 宽的柱子，X 坐标直接用 i，不留任何间隙
        const x = i;
        const y = barCanvas.height - barHeight;
        barCtx.fillRect(x, y, barWidth, barHeight);
      }

      requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }
  </script>

4.5.5 镜像柱状图-线圆角

  1. 代码示例

    <!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">

<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>上下镜像圆角频谱图</title>
  <style>
    #db {
      font-size: 20px;
      margin: 10px 0;
      display: inline-block;
    }

    .warn {
      color: #f44;
    }

    canvas {

    }
  </style>
</head>

<body>
  <!-- 增加高度以展示上下镜像效果 -->
  <canvas id="barCanvas" width="600" height="300"></canvas>

  <div class="audio-content">
    <audio id="audioPlayer" controls src="./audio/01.mp3"></audio>
    <div>当前分贝：<span id="db">0</span> dB</div>
  </div>

  <script>
    const barCanvas = document.getElementById('barCanvas');
    const barCtx = barCanvas.getContext('2d');
    const dbEl = document.getElementById('db');
    const audioEl = document.getElementById('audioPlayer');

    let audioContext, analyser, source;
    let isAudioContextReady = false;

    const bufferLength = 2048;
    const fftBinCount = 1024;
    const dataArray = new Uint8Array(fftBinCount);

    const AVG_FRAME = 60;
    let dbHistory = [];
    const BAR_COUNT = 64; // 柱子数量

    audioEl.onplay = async () => {
      if (!isAudioContextReady) {
        audioContext = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        analyser = audioContext.createAnalyser();
        analyser.fftSize = bufferLength;
        analyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.8;

        source = audioContext.createMediaElementSource(audioEl);
        source.connect(analyser);
        analyser.connect(audioContext.destination);
        isAudioContextReady = true;
      }
      loop();
    };

    /**
     * 绘制单侧圆角的柱子
     * @param {Number} direction -1: 向上生长(上半部分), 1: 向下生长(下半部分)
     */
    function drawMirrorBar(ctx, x, y, w, h, r, direction) {
      if (h <= 0) return;
      r = Math.min(r, w / 2); // 圆角不能超过宽度的一半

      ctx.beginPath();
      if (direction === -1) {
        // 上半部分：从中心向上，圆角在顶部
        ctx.moveTo(x, y); // 左下角
        ctx.lineTo(x + w, y); // 右下角
        ctx.lineTo(x + w, y - h + r); // 右侧向上
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y - h, x + w - r, y - h); // 右上圆角
        ctx.lineTo(x + r, y - h); // 顶部
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y - h, x, y - h + r); // 左上圆角
      } else {
        // 下半部分：从中心向下，圆角在底部
        ctx.moveTo(x, y); // 左上角
        ctx.lineTo(x + w, y); // 右上角
        ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r); // 右侧向下
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h); // 右下圆角
        ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h); // 底部
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r); // 左下圆角
      }
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
    }

    function loop() {
      if (audioEl.paused) return;

      // 1. 计算 RMS 分贝
      analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(dataArray);
      let sumSq = 0;
      for (let v of dataArray) {
        const n = (v / 128.0) - 1.0;
        sumSq += n * n;
      }
      const rms = Math.sqrt(sumSq / bufferLength);
      let instantDb = 20 * Math.log10(Math.max(rms, 0.00001));

      dbHistory.push(instantDb);
      if (dbHistory.length > AVG_FRAME) dbHistory.shift();
      const avgDb = dbHistory.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) / dbHistory.length;

      dbEl.textContent = avgDb.toFixed(1);
      dbEl.classList.toggle('warn', avgDb > -20);

      // 2. 获取频域数据
      analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);

      // 3. 绘制上下镜像图
      barCtx.fillStyle = '#000';
      barCtx.fillRect(0, 0, barCanvas.width, barCanvas.height);

      const centerY = barCanvas.height / 2;
      const barWidth = barCanvas.width / BAR_COUNT;
      const step = Math.floor(fftBinCount / BAR_COUNT);
      const gap = 1; // 柱子间隙

      for (let i = 0; i < BAR_COUNT; i++) {
        let sum = 0;
        for (let j = 0; j < step; j++) {
          sum += dataArray[i * step + j];
        }
        const avgVal = sum / step;

        // 限制最大高度，留出上下边距
        const maxBarHeight = centerY - 5;
        const barHeight = (avgVal / 255) * maxBarHeight;

        // 渐变色：低频绿 -> 高频红
        const hue = 120 - (i / BAR_COUNT) * 120;
        barCtx.fillStyle = `hsl(${hue}, 100%, 50%)`;

        const x = i * barWidth;
        const w = barWidth - gap;
        const r = w / 2; // 圆角半径设为宽度的一半，形成胶囊状末端

        // 绘制上半部分（向上生长）
        drawMirrorBar(barCtx, x, centerY, w, barHeight, r, -1);

        // 绘制下半部分（向下生长，完全镜像）
        drawMirrorBar(barCtx, x, centerY, w, barHeight, r, 1);
      }

      requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }
  </script>
</body>

</html>

4.5.6 对称柱状图-基础

  1. 代码示例

    <!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>左右对称中心展开频谱图</title>

    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <canvas id="barCanvas" width="600" height="200"></canvas>

  <div class="audio-content">
    <audio id="audioPlayer" controls src="./audio/01.mp3"></audio>
    <div>当前分贝：<span id="db">0</span> dB</div>
  </div>

  <script>
    const barCanvas = document.getElementById('barCanvas');
    const barCtx = barCanvas.getContext('2d');
    const dbEl = document.getElementById('db');
    const audioEl = document.getElementById('audioPlayer');

    let audioContext, analyser, source;
    let isAudioContextReady = false;

    const bufferLength = 2048;
    const fftBinCount = 1024;
    const dataArray = new Uint8Array(fftBinCount);

    const AVG_FRAME = 60;
    let dbHistory = [];
    const BAR_COUNT = 64; 

    audioEl.onplay = async () => {
      if (!isAudioContextReady) {
        audioContext = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        analyser = audioContext.createAnalyser();
        analyser.fftSize = bufferLength;
        analyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.8;

        source = audioContext.createMediaElementSource(audioEl);
        source.connect(analyser);
        analyser.connect(audioContext.destination);
        isAudioContextReady = true;
      }
      loop();
    };

    function loop() {
      if (audioEl.paused) return;

      // 1. 计算 RMS 分贝
      analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(dataArray);
      let sumSq = 0;
      for (let v of dataArray) {
        const n = (v / 128.0) - 1.0;
        sumSq += n * n;
      }
      const rms = Math.sqrt(sumSq / bufferLength);
      let instantDb = 20 * Math.log10(Math.max(rms, 0.00001));

      dbHistory.push(instantDb);
      if (dbHistory.length > AVG_FRAME) dbHistory.shift();
      const avgDb = dbHistory.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) / dbHistory.length;

      dbEl.textContent = avgDb.toFixed(1);
      dbEl.classList.toggle('warn', avgDb > -20);

      // 2. 获取频域数据
      analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);

      // 3. 绘制左右对称柱状图
      // 清空画布
      barCtx.fillStyle = '#000';
      barCtx.fillRect(0, 0, barCanvas.width, barCanvas.height);

      const centerX = barCanvas.width / 2;
      const barWidth = barCanvas.width / BAR_COUNT;
      const step = Math.floor(fftBinCount / BAR_COUNT);
      const halfCount = BAR_COUNT / 2;

      for (let i = 0; i < halfCount; i++) {
        // 获取当前频率区间的平均值
        let sum = 0;
        for (let j = 0; j < step; j++) {
          sum += dataArray[i * step + j];
        }
        const avgVal = sum / step;
        const barHeight = (avgVal / 255) * barCanvas.height;

        // 渐变色：中间（低频）为绿色，向两侧（高频）变为红色
        const hue = 120 - (i / halfCount) * 120;
        barCtx.fillStyle = `hsl(${hue}, 100%, 50%)`;

        // 计算左右两侧柱子的 X 坐标
        // 右半部分：从中心向右展开
        const rightX = centerX + (i * barWidth);
        // 左半部分：从中心向左展开
        const leftX = centerX - ((i + 1) * barWidth); 

        // 绘制右侧柱子
        barCtx.fillRect(rightX, barCanvas.height - barHeight, barWidth - 1, barHeight);
        // 绘制左侧柱子
        barCtx.fillRect(leftX, barCanvas.height - barHeight, barWidth - 1, barHeight);
      }

      requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }
  </script>
</body>
</html>

        source.connect(analyser);
        analyser.connect(audioContext.destination);
        isAudioContextReady = true;
      }
      loop();
    };

    function loop() {
      if (audioEl.paused) return;

      // 1. 计算 RMS 分贝
      analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(dataArray);
      let sumSq = 0;
      for (let v of dataArray) {
        const n = (v / 128.0) - 1.0;
        sumSq += n * n;
      }
      const rms = Math.sqrt(sumSq / bufferLength);
      let instantDb = 20 * Math.log10(Math.max(rms, 0.00001));

      dbHistory.push(instantDb);
      if (dbHistory.length > AVG_FRAME) dbHistory.shift();
      const avgDb = dbHistory.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) / dbHistory.length;

      dbEl.textContent = avgDb.toFixed(1);
      dbEl.classList.toggle('warn', avgDb > -20);

      // 2. 获取频域数据
      analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);

      // 3. 绘制左右对称柱状图
      barCtx.fillStyle = '#000';
      barCtx.fillRect(0, 0, barCanvas.width, barCanvas.height);

      const barWidth = barCanvas.width / BAR_COUNT;
      const step = Math.floor(fftBinCount / BAR_COUNT);
      const centerX = barCanvas.width / 2;

      for (let i = 0; i < BAR_COUNT; i++) {
        // 取每个区间的平均值
        let sum = 0;
        for (let j = 0; j < step; j++) {
          sum += dataArray[i * step + j];
        }
        const avgVal = sum / step;
        const barHeight = (avgVal / 255) * barCanvas.height;

        // 渐变色：低频(中央)绿 -> 高频(两侧)红
        const hue = 120 - (i / BAR_COUNT) * 120;
        barCtx.fillStyle = `hsl(${hue}, 100%, 50%)`;

        // 核心逻辑：从中心向两侧展开绘制
        let x;
        if (i % 2 === 0) {
          // 偶数索引：画在中心右侧
          x = centerX + (i / 2) * barWidth;
        } else {
          // 奇数索引：画在中心左侧
          x = centerX - ((i + 1) / 2) * barWidth;
        }

        const y = barCanvas.height - barHeight;
        barCtx.fillRect(x, y, barWidth - 1, barHeight);
      }

  1. 代码示例

    <!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">

<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>外环柱状图</title>
  <style>
    #db {

      color: #f44;

    canvas {

</head>

<body>
  <canvas id="barCanvas" width="400" height="400"></canvas>
  <div class="audio-content">
    <audio id="audioPlayer" controls src="./audio/01.mp3"></audio>
    <div>当前分贝：<span id="db">0</span> dB</div>
  </div>

  <script>
    const barCanvas = document.getElementById('barCanvas');
    const barCtx = barCanvas.getContext('2d');
    const dbEl = document.getElementById('db');
    const audioEl = document.getElementById('audioPlayer');

    let audioContext, analyser, source;
    let isAudioContextReady = false;
    const bufferLength = 2048;
    const fftBinCount = 1024;
    const dataArray = new Uint8Array(fftBinCount);
    const AVG_FRAME = 60;
    let dbHistory = [];
    const BAR_COUNT = 128;

    audioEl.onplay = async () => {
      if (!isAudioContextReady) {
        audioContext = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        analyser = audioContext.createAnalyser();
        analyser.fftSize = bufferLength;
        analyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.8;
        source = audioContext.createMediaElementSource(audioEl);
        source.connect(analyser);
        analyser.connect(audioContext.destination);
        isAudioContextReady = true;
      }
      loop();
    };

    function loop() {
      if (audioEl.paused) return;

      // 1. 计算 RMS 分贝
      analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(dataArray);
      let sumSq = 0;
      for (let v of dataArray) {
        const n = (v / 128.0) - 1.0;
        sumSq += n * n;
      }
      const rms = Math.sqrt(sumSq / bufferLength);
      let instantDb = 20 * Math.log10(Math.max(rms, 0.00001));
      dbHistory.push(instantDb);
      if (dbHistory.length > AVG_FRAME) dbHistory.shift();
      const avgDb = dbHistory.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) / dbHistory.length;
      dbEl.textContent = avgDb.toFixed(1);
      dbEl.classList.toggle('warn', avgDb > -20);

      // 2. 获取频域数据
      analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);

      // 3. 绘制环形频谱
      const centerX = barCanvas.width / 2;
      const centerY = barCanvas.height / 2;
      const radius = 100;

      barCtx.fillStyle = '#000';
      barCtx.fillRect(0, 0, barCanvas.width, barCanvas.height);

      // 【核心修复】绘制渐变内圆
      // 1. 将渐变起点旋转 -Math.PI / 2，使其与柱子的起点（正上方）对齐
      const conicGrad = barCtx.createConicGradient(-Math.PI / 2, centerX, centerY);

      // 2. 让起点(0)和终点(1)的颜色完全一致，确保首尾无缝衔接
      conicGrad.addColorStop(0, 'hsla(120, 100%, 50%, 0.5)');   // 起点：绿色
      conicGrad.addColorStop(0.5, 'hsla(60, 100%, 50%, 0.5)');  // 中间：黄色
      conicGrad.addColorStop(1, 'hsla(0, 100%, 50%, 1.5)');     // 终点：红色（与起点颜色同属	暖色过渡，视觉无缝）


      barCtx.beginPath();
      barCtx.arc(centerX, centerY, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      barCtx.strokeStyle = conicGrad;
      barCtx.lineWidth = 1;
      barCtx.stroke();

      const step = Math.floor(fftBinCount / BAR_COUNT);
      const angleStep = (Math.PI * 2) / BAR_COUNT;
      const startOffset = -Math.PI / 2;

      for (let i = 0; i < BAR_COUNT; i++) {
        let sum = 0;
        for (let j = 0; j < step; j++) {
          sum += dataArray[i * step + j];
        }
        const avgVal = sum / step;
        const barLength = (avgVal / 255) * 80;

        const hue = 120 - (i / BAR_COUNT) * 120;
        barCtx.fillStyle = `hsl(${hue}, 100%, 50%)`;

        const startAngle = startOffset + (i * angleStep);
        const endAngle = startAngle + angleStep;

        barCtx.beginPath();
        barCtx.moveTo(centerX + radius * Math.cos(startAngle), centerY + radius * Math.sin	(startAngle));
        barCtx.lineTo(centerX + (radius + barLength) * Math.cos(startAngle), centerY + 	(radius + barLength) * Math.sin(startAngle));
        barCtx.arc(centerX, centerY, radius + barLength, startAngle, endAngle);
        barCtx.lineTo(centerX + radius * Math.cos(endAngle), centerY + radius * Math.sin	(endAngle));
        barCtx.arc(centerX, centerY, radius, endAngle, startAngle, true);
        barCtx.closePath();
        barCtx.fill();
      }

      // 4. 画中心实心黑圆
      barCtx.beginPath();
      barCtx.arc(centerX, centerY, radius - 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      barCtx.fillStyle = '#000';
      barCtx.fill();

      requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }
  </script>
</body>

</html>

    <div>当前分贝：<span id="db">0</span> dB</div>
  </div>

  <script>
    const barCanvas = document.getElementById('barCanvas');
    const barCtx = barCanvas.getContext('2d');
    const dbEl = document.getElementById('db');
    const audioEl = document.getElementById('audioPlayer');

    let audioContext, analyser, source;
    let isAudioContextReady = false;

    const bufferLength = 2048;
    const fftBinCount = 1024;
    const dataArray = new Uint8Array(fftBinCount);
    const BAR_COUNT = 128;

    // RMS 平滑计算相关变量
    const AVG_FRAME = 60;
    let dbHistory = [];

    // 定义内外半径
    const OUTER_RADIUS = 180;
    const MAX_BAR_LENGTH = 140;

    audioEl.onplay = async () => {
      if (!isAudioContextReady) {
        audioContext = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        analyser = audioContext.createAnalyser();
        analyser.fftSize = bufferLength;
        analyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.8;
        source = audioContext.createMediaElementSource(audioEl);
        source.connect(analyser);
        analyser.connect(audioContext.destination);
        isAudioContextReady = true;
      }
      if (audioContext.state === 'suspended') await audioContext.resume();
      loop();
    };

    function loop() {
      if (audioEl.paused) return;

      // 1. 计算 RMS 分贝
      analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(dataArray);
      let sumSq = 0;
      for (let v of dataArray) {
        const n = (v / 128.0) - 1.0;
        sumSq += n * n;
      }

      let instantDb = 20 * Math.log10(Math.max(rms, 0.00001));

      dbHistory.push(instantDb);
      if (dbHistory.length > AVG_FRAME) dbHistory.shift();
      const avgDb = dbHistory.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) / dbHistory.length;

      dbEl.textContent = avgDb.toFixed(1);
      dbEl.classList.toggle('warn', avgDb > -20);

      // 2. 获取频域数据
      analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);

      const centerX = barCanvas.width / 2;
      const centerY = barCanvas.height / 2;

      barCtx.fillStyle = '#000';
      barCtx.fillRect(0, 0, barCanvas.width, barCanvas.height);

      // 绘制外环基准线
      barCtx.beginPath();
      barCtx.arc(centerX, centerY, OUTER_RADIUS, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      barCtx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)';
      barCtx.lineWidth = 2;
      barCtx.stroke();

      const step = Math.floor(fftBinCount / BAR_COUNT);
      const angleStep = (Math.PI * 2) / BAR_COUNT;
      const startOffset = -Math.PI / 2; // 从正上方开始

      for (let i = 0; i < BAR_COUNT; i++) {
        let sum = 0;
        for (let j = 0; j < step; j++) {
          sum += dataArray[i * step + j];
        }
        const avgVal = sum / step;

        const barLength = (avgVal / 255) * MAX_BAR_LENGTH;
        const innerR = Math.max(OUTER_RADIUS - barLength, 10);

        const hue = 120 - (i / BAR_COUNT) * 120;
        barCtx.fillStyle = `hsl(${hue}, 100%, 50%)`;

        const startAngle = startOffset + (i * angleStep);
        const endAngle = startAngle + angleStep;

        barCtx.beginPath();
        barCtx.moveTo(centerX + OUTER_RADIUS * Math.cos(startAngle), centerY + OUTER_RADIUS 	* Math.sin(startAngle));
        barCtx.arc(centerX, centerY, OUTER_RADIUS, startAngle, endAngle);
        barCtx.lineTo(centerX + innerR * Math.cos(endAngle), centerY + innerR * Math.sin	(endAngle));
        barCtx.arc(centerX, centerY, innerR, endAngle, startAngle, true);
        barCtx.closePath();
        barCtx.fill();
      }

      requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }
  </script>
</body>

</html>

4.5.11 环形镜像柱状图

  1. 代码示例

    <!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>单环双向镜像环形频谱</title>
  <style>
    #db {
      font-size: 20px;
      margin: 10px 0;
      display: inline-block;
    }
    .warn {
      color: #f44;
    }
    canvas {
      background: #000;
      display: block;
      margin-top: 10px;
    }
    .audio-content {
      margin-top: 20px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <canvas id="barCanvas" width="500" height="500"></canvas>
  <div class="audio-content">
    <audio id="audioPlayer" controls src="./audio/01.mp3">
    <div>当前分贝：<span id="db">0</span> dB</div>
  </div>
  <script>
    const barCanvas = document.getElementById('barCanvas');
    const barCtx = barCanvas.getContext('2d');
    const dbEl = document.getElementById('db');
    const audioEl = document.getElementById('audioPlayer');
    let audioContext, analyser, source;
    let isAudioContextReady = false;

    const bufferLength = 2048;
    const fftBinCount = 1024;
    const dataArray = new Uint8Array(fftBinCount);
    const AVG_FRAME = 60;
    let dbHistory = [];

    const BAR_COUNT = 128;
    const BASE_R = 160;        // 基准圆半径（镜像中线）
    const MAX_OFFSET = 100;    // 双向最大偏移：向外+MAX_OFFSET，向内‑MAX_OFFSET

    audioEl.onplay = async () => {
      if (!isAudioContextReady) {
        audioContext = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        analyser = audioContext.createAnalyser();
        analyser.fftSize = bufferLength;
        analyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.8;
        source = audioContext.createMediaElementSource(audioEl);
        source.connect(analyser);
        analyser.connect(audioContext.destination);
        isAudioContextReady = true;
      }
      if (audioContext.state === 'suspended') await audioContext.resume();
      loop();
    };

    function loop() {
      if (audioEl.paused) return;

      analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(dataArray);
      let sumSq = 0;
      for (let v of dataArray) {
        const n = (v / 128.0) - 1.0;
        sumSq += n * n;
      }
      const rms = Math.sqrt(sumSq / bufferLength);
      let instantDb = 20 * Math.log10(Math.max(rms, 0.00001));
      dbHistory.push(instantDb);
      if (dbHistory.length > AVG_FRAME) dbHistory.shift();
      const avgDb = dbHistory.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) / dbHistory.length;
      dbEl.textContent = avgDb.toFixed(1);
      dbEl.classList.toggle('warn', avgDb > -20);

      analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);

      const centerX = barCanvas.width / 2;
      const centerY = barCanvas.height / 2;
      barCtx.fillStyle = '#000';
      barCtx.fillRect(0, 0, barCanvas.width, barCanvas.height);

      // 绘制中间基准参考圈
      barCtx.beginPath();
      barCtx.arc(centerX, centerY, BASE_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      barCtx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)';
      barCtx.lineWidth = 1;
      barCtx.stroke();

      const step = Math.floor(fftBinCount / BAR_COUNT);
      const angleStep = (Math.PI * 2) / BAR_COUNT;
      const startOffset = -Math.PI / 2;

      for (let i = 0; i < BAR_COUNT; i++) {
        let sum = 0;
        for (let j = 0; j < step; j++) {
          sum += dataArray[i * step + j];
        }
        const avgVal = sum / step;
        const offset = (avgVal / 255) * MAX_OFFSET;

        // 双向半径：外侧R、内侧R
        const rOuter = BASE_R + offset;
        const rInner = Math.max(BASE_R - offset, 10);

        const hue = 120 - (i / BAR_COUNT) * 120;
        barCtx.fillStyle = `hsl(${hue}, 100%, 50%)`;

        const startAngle = startOffset + i * angleStep;
        const endAngle = startAngle + angleStep;

        // 单path绘制一片双向镜像扇条：外圆弧 → 内圆弧闭合
        barCtx.beginPath();
        barCtx.moveTo(
          centerX + rOuter * Math.cos(startAngle),
          centerY + rOuter * Math.sin(startAngle)
        );
        barCtx.arc(centerX, centerY, rOuter, startAngle, endAngle);
        barCtx.lineTo(
          centerX + rInner * Math.cos(endAngle),
          centerY + rInner * Math.sin(endAngle)
        );
        barCtx.arc(centerX, centerY, rInner, endAngle, startAngle, true);
        barCtx.closePath();
        barCtx.fill();
      }

      // 中心黑色遮罩
      barCtx.beginPath();
      barCtx.arc(centerX, centerY, 15, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      barCtx.fillStyle = '#000';
      barCtx.fill();

      requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }
  </script>
</body>
</html>

4.6.1 基础折线图

  1. 代码示例

    <!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">

<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>纯描边频谱折线图</title>
  <style>
    #db {
      font-size: 20px;
      margin: 10px 0;
      display: inline-block;
    }

    .warn {
      color: #f44;
    }

    canvas {
      background: #000;
      border-radius: 6px;
      display: block;
      margin-top: 10px;
    }

    .audio-content {
      margin-top: 20px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }
  </style>
</head>

<body>
  <canvas id="barCanvas" width="600" height="200"></canvas>
  <div class="audio-content">
    <audio id="audioPlayer" controls src="./audio/01.mp3"></audio>
    <div>当前分贝：<span id="db">0</span> dB</div>
  </div>

  <script>
    const barCanvas = document.getElementById('barCanvas');
    const barCtx = barCanvas.getContext('2d');
    const dbEl = document.getElementById('db');
    const audioEl = document.getElementById('audioPlayer');

    let audioContext, analyser, source;
    let isAudioContextReady = false;

    const bufferLength = 2048;
    const fftBinCount = 1024;
    const dataArray = new Uint8Array(fftBinCount);
    const timeDataArray = new Uint8Array(bufferLength); // 独立数组供 RMS 使用

    const AVG_FRAME = 60;
    let dbHistory = [];
    const BAR_COUNT = 64;

    audioEl.onplay = async () => {
      if (!isAudioContextReady) {
        audioContext = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        analyser = audioContext.createAnalyser();
        analyser.fftSize = bufferLength;
        analyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.8;
        source = audioContext.createMediaElementSource(audioEl);
        source.connect(analyser);
        analyser.connect(audioContext.destination);
        isAudioContextReady = true;
      }
      if (audioContext.state === 'suspended') await audioContext.resume();
      loop();
    };

    function loop() {
      if (audioEl.paused) return;

      // 1. 计算 RMS 分贝
      analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(timeDataArray);
      let sumSq = 0;
      for (let v of timeDataArray) {
        const n = (v / 128.0) - 1.0;
        sumSq += n * n;
      }
      const rms = Math.sqrt(sumSq / bufferLength);
      const instantDb = 20 * Math.log10(Math.max(rms, 0.00001));
      dbHistory.push(instantDb);
      if (dbHistory.length > AVG_FRAME) dbHistory.shift();
      const avgDb = dbHistory.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) / dbHistory.length;
      dbEl.textContent = avgDb.toFixed(1);
      dbEl.classList.toggle('warn', avgDb > -20);

      // 2. 获取频域数据
      analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);

      // 3. 清空画布
      barCtx.fillStyle = '#000';
      barCtx.fillRect(0, 0, barCanvas.width, barCanvas.height);

      const barWidth = barCanvas.width / BAR_COUNT;
      const step = Math.floor(fftBinCount / BAR_COUNT);

      // --- 开始绘制纯描边折线 ---
      barCtx.beginPath();

      // 设置描边样式
      const gradient = barCtx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, barCanvas.width, 0);
      gradient.addColorStop(0, '#00ff00'); // 低频绿色
      gradient.addColorStop(1, '#ff0000'); // 高频红色

      barCtx.strokeStyle = gradient;
      barCtx.lineWidth = 3; // 线条粗细
      barCtx.lineJoin = 'round'; // 让拐角圆润
      barCtx.lineCap = 'round';  // 让端点圆润

      for (let i = 0; i < BAR_COUNT; i++) {
        let sum = 0;
        for (let j = 0; j < step; j++) {
          sum += dataArray[i * step + j];
        }
        const avgVal = sum / step;
        const barHeight = (avgVal / 255) * barCanvas.height;

        const x = i * barWidth + barWidth / 2; // 取柱子中心点，视觉更居中
        const y = barCanvas.height - barHeight;

        if (i === 0) {
          barCtx.moveTo(x, y);
        } else {
          barCtx.lineTo(x, y);
        }
      }

      // 【核心改动】不再闭合路径，不再填充，只描边
      barCtx.stroke();
      // ----------------------------------

      requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }
  </script>
</body>

</html>

    <!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">

<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>连贯的频谱折线图</title>
  <style>

    }

    .warn {
      color: #f44;
    }

    canvas {

    }

    .audio-content {
      margin-top: 20px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;

  </style>
</head>

<body>
  <!-- 单个 Canvas -->
  <canvas id="barCanvas" width="600" height="200"></canvas>

  <div class="audio-content">
    <audio id="audioPlayer" controls src="./audio/01.mp3"></audio>
    <div>当前分贝：<span id="db">0</span> dB</div>
  </div>

  <script>
    const barCanvas = document.getElementById('barCanvas');
    const barCtx = barCanvas.getContext('2d');
    const dbEl = document.getElementById('db');
    const audioEl = document.getElementById('audioPlayer');

    let audioContext, analyser, source;
    let isAudioContextReady = false;

    const bufferLength = 2048;
    const fftBinCount = 1024;
    const dataArray = new Uint8Array(fftBinCount);

    const AVG_FRAME = 60;
    let dbHistory = [];
    const BAR_COUNT = 64; // 折线图的关键点数量

    audioEl.onplay = async () => {
      if (!isAudioContextReady) {
        audioContext = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        analyser = audioContext.createAnalyser();
        analyser.fftSize = bufferLength;
        analyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.8;

        source = audioContext.createMediaElementSource(audioEl);
        source.connect(analyser);
        analyser.connect(audioContext.destination);
        isAudioContextReady = true;
      }
      loop();
    };

    function loop() {
      if (audioEl.paused) return;

      // 1. 计算 RMS 分贝
      analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(dataArray);
      let sumSq = 0;
      for (let v of dataArray) {
        const n = (v / 128.0) - 1.0;
        sumSq += n * n;
      }
      const rms = Math.sqrt(sumSq / bufferLength);
      let instantDb = 20 * Math.log10(Math.max(rms, 0.00001));

      dbHistory.push(instantDb);
      if (dbHistory.length > AVG_FRAME) dbHistory.shift();
      const avgDb = dbHistory.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) / dbHistory.length;

      dbEl.textContent = avgDb.toFixed(1);
      dbEl.classList.toggle('warn', avgDb > -20);

      // 2. 获取频域数据
      analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);

      // 3. 清空画布
      barCtx.fillStyle = '#000';
      barCtx.fillRect(0, 0, barCanvas.width, barCanvas.height);

      const barWidth = barCanvas.width / BAR_COUNT;
      const step = Math.floor(fftBinCount / BAR_COUNT);

      // --- 开始绘制连贯的折线填充图 ---
      barCtx.beginPath();
      barCtx.moveTo(0, barCanvas.height); // 起点：左下角

      for (let i = 0; i < BAR_COUNT; i++) {
        // 取每个区间的平均值
        let sum = 0;
        for (let j = 0; j < step; j++) {
          sum += dataArray[i * step + j];
        }
        const avgVal = sum / step;
        const barHeight = (avgVal / 255) * barCanvas.height;

        // 计算每个顶点的坐标并连线
        const x = i * barWidth;
        const y = barCanvas.height - barHeight;
        barCtx.lineTo(x, y);
      }

      barCtx.lineTo(barCanvas.width, barCanvas.height); // 连线到右下角
      barCtx.closePath(); // 闭合路径回到左下角

      // 设置填充颜色（这里沿用了之前的渐变逻辑，你可以随意更改）
      const gradient = barCtx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, barCanvas.width, 0);
      gradient.addColorStop(0, '#00ff00'); // 低频绿色
      gradient.addColorStop(1, '#ff0000'); // 高频红色
      barCtx.fillStyle = gradient;

      barCtx.fill(); // 填充整个路径区域

      // 可选：在顶部加一条亮线，让轮廓更清晰
      barCtx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
      barCtx.lineWidth = 1;
      barCtx.stroke();
      // ----------------------------------

      requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }
  </script>
</body>

</html>

  <script>
    const barCanvas = document.getElementById('barCanvas');
    const barCtx = barCanvas.getContext('2d');
    const dbEl = document.getElementById('db');
    const audioEl = document.getElementById('audioPlayer');
    let audioContext, analyser, source;

    const AVG_FRAME = 60;

    const BAR_COUNT = 64;

        analyser.connect(audioContext.destination);
        isAudioContextReady = true;
      }
      loop();
    };

    function loop() {
      if (audioEl.paused) return;

      analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(dataArray);
      let sumSq = 0;
      for (let v of dataArray) {
        const n = (v / 128.0) - 1.0;
        sumSq += n * n;
      }
      const rms = Math.sqrt(sumSq / bufferLength);
      let instantDb = 20 * Math.log10(Math.max(rms, 0.00001));
      dbHistory.push(instantDb);
      if (dbHistory.length > AVG_FRAME) dbHistory.shift();
      const avgDb = dbHistory.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) / dbHistory.length;
      dbEl.textContent = avgDb.toFixed(1);
      dbEl.classList.toggle('warn', avgDb > -20);

      analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);

      barCtx.fillStyle = '#000';
      barCtx.fillRect(0, 0, barCanvas.width, barCanvas.height);

      const centerY = barCanvas.height / 2;
      const barWidth = barCanvas.width / BAR_COUNT;
      const step = Math.floor(fftBinCount / BAR_COUNT);

      const points = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < BAR_COUNT; i++) {
        let sum = 0;
        for (let j = 0; j < step; j++) {
          sum += dataArray[i * step + j];
        }
        const avgVal = sum / step;
        const up = (avgVal / 255) * centerY;
        const x = i * barWidth;
        points.push({ x, up });
      }

      // 上下镜像填充区域
      barCtx.beginPath();
      barCtx.moveTo(points[0].x, centerY - points[0].up);

      for (const p of points) {
        barCtx.lineTo(p.x, centerY - p.up);
      }

      const last = points[points.length - 1];
      barCtx.lineTo(last.x, centerY + last.up);

      for (let i = points.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const p = points[i];
        barCtx.lineTo(p.x, centerY + p.up);
      }

      barCtx.closePath();

      const gradient = barCtx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, barCanvas.width, 0);
      gradient.addColorStop(0, '#00ff00');
      gradient.addColorStop(1, '#ff0000');
      barCtx.fillStyle = gradient;
      barCtx.fill();

      requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }

    <!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">

  <style>

    }

</head>
<body>
  <canvas id="barCanvas" width="600" height="300"></canvas>

  <div class="audio-content">
    <audio id="audioPlayer" controls src="./audio/01.mp3"></audio>
    <div>当前分贝：<span id="db">0</span> dB</div>
  </div>

  <script>
    const barCanvas = document.getElementById('barCanvas');
    const barCtx = barCanvas.getContext('2d');
    const dbEl = document.getElementById('db');
    const audioEl = document.getElementById('audioPlayer');

    let audioContext, analyser, source;
    let isAudioContextReady = false;

    const bufferLength = 2048;
    const fftBinCount = 1024;
    const dataArray = new Uint8Array(fftBinCount);

    const AVG_FRAME = 60;
    let dbHistory = [];
    const BAR_COUNT = 64;

    audioEl.onplay = async () => {
      if (!isAudioContextReady) {
        audioContext = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        analyser = audioContext.createAnalyser();
        analyser.fftSize = bufferLength;
        analyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.8;

        source = audioContext.createMediaElementSource(audioEl);
        source.connect(analyser);
        analyser.connect(audioContext.destination);
        isAudioContextReady = true;
      }
      loop();
    };

    function loop() {
      if (audioEl.paused) return;

      // 1. 计算 RMS 分贝
      analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(dataArray);
      let sumSq = 0;
      for (let v of dataArray) {
        const n = (v / 128.0) - 1.0;
        sumSq += n * n;
      }
      const rms = Math.sqrt(sumSq / bufferLength);
      let instantDb = 20 * Math.log10(Math.max(rms, 0.00001));

      dbHistory.push(instantDb);
      if (dbHistory.length > AVG_FRAME) dbHistory.shift();
      const avgDb = dbHistory.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) / dbHistory.length;

      dbEl.textContent = avgDb.toFixed(1);
      dbEl.classList.toggle('warn', avgDb > -20);

      // 2. 获取频域数据
      analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);

      // 3. 清空画布
      barCtx.fillStyle = '#000';
      barCtx.fillRect(0, 0, barCanvas.width, barCanvas.height);

      const centerY = barCanvas.height / 2;
      const barWidth = barCanvas.width / BAR_COUNT;
      const step = Math.floor(fftBinCount / BAR_COUNT);
      const gap = 2; // 柱子水平间隙

      for (let i = 0; i < BAR_COUNT; i++) {
        let sum = 0;
        for (let j = 0; j < step; j++) {
          sum += dataArray[i * step + j];
        }
        const avgVal = sum / step;

        const maxBarHeight = centerY - 5;
        const barHeight = (avgVal / 255) * maxBarHeight;

        // 渐变色：低频绿 -> 高频红
        const hue = 120 - (i / BAR_COUNT) * 120;
        barCtx.strokeStyle = `hsl(${hue}, 100%, 50%)`;
        barCtx.lineWidth = 1.5;

        const x = i * barWidth;
        const w = barWidth - gap;

        // 如果高度太小则不绘制，避免极小的图形
        if (barHeight <= 0) continue;

        // 【核心修改】手动绘制三条边，去除靠近中心的边

        // 绘制上半部分（去除了底边/中心边）
        // 顺序：左下角(中心) -> 左侧边 -> 顶边 -> 右侧边(到中心)
        barCtx.beginPath();
        barCtx.moveTo(x, centerY); 
        barCtx.lineTo(x, centerY - barHeight); 
        barCtx.lineTo(x + w, centerY - barHeight);
        barCtx.lineTo(x + w, centerY);
        barCtx.stroke();

        // 绘制下半部分（去除了顶边/中心边）
        // 顺序：左上角(中心) -> 左侧边 -> 底边 -> 右侧边(到中心)
        barCtx.beginPath();
        barCtx.moveTo(x, centerY);
        barCtx.lineTo(x, centerY + barHeight);
        barCtx.lineTo(x + w, centerY + barHeight);
        barCtx.lineTo(x + w, centerY);
        barCtx.stroke();
      }

      requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }
  </script>
</body>
</html>

4.6.5 镜像描边圆角柱

  1. 代码示例

    <!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>上下镜像半圆频谱图</title>
  <style>
    #db {
      font-size: 20px;
      margin: 10px 0;
      display: inline-block;
    }
    .warn {
      color: #f44;
    }
    canvas {
      background: #000;
      border-radius: 6px;
      display: block;
      margin-top: 10px;
    }
    .audio-content {
      margin-top: 20px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <canvas id="barCanvas" width="600" height="300"></canvas>

  <div class="audio-content">
    <audio id="audioPlayer" controls src="./audio/01.mp3"></audio>
    <div>当前分贝：<span id="db">0</span> dB</div>
  </div>

  <script>
    const barCanvas = document.getElementById('barCanvas');
    const barCtx = barCanvas.getContext('2d');
    const dbEl = document.getElementById('db');
    const audioEl = document.getElementById('audioPlayer');

    let audioContext, analyser, source;
    let isAudioContextReady = false;

    const bufferLength = 2048;
    const fftBinCount = 1024;
    const dataArray = new Uint8Array(fftBinCount);

    const AVG_FRAME = 60;
    let dbHistory = [];
    const BAR_COUNT = 64;

    audioEl.onplay = async () => {
      if (!isAudioContextReady) {
        audioContext = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        analyser = audioContext.createAnalyser();
        analyser.fftSize = bufferLength;
        analyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.8;

        source = audioContext.createMediaElementSource(audioEl);
        source.connect(analyser);
        analyser.connect(audioContext.destination);
        isAudioContextReady = true;
      }
      loop();
    };

    function loop() {
      if (audioEl.paused) return;

      // 1. 计算 RMS 分贝
      analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(dataArray);
      let sumSq = 0;
      for (let v of dataArray) {
        const n = (v / 128.0) - 1.0;
        sumSq += n * n;
      }
      const rms = Math.sqrt(sumSq / bufferLength);
      let instantDb = 20 * Math.log10(Math.max(rms, 0.00001));

      dbHistory.push(instantDb);
      if (dbHistory.length > AVG_FRAME) dbHistory.shift();
      const avgDb = dbHistory.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) / dbHistory.length;

      dbEl.textContent = avgDb.toFixed(1);
      dbEl.classList.toggle('warn', avgDb > -20);

      // 2. 获取频域数据
      analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);

      // 3. 清空画布
      barCtx.fillStyle = '#000';
      barCtx.fillRect(0, 0, barCanvas.width, barCanvas.height);

      const centerY = barCanvas.height / 2;
      const barWidth = barCanvas.width / BAR_COUNT;
      const step = Math.floor(fftBinCount / BAR_COUNT);
      const gap = 2; // 柱子水平间隙

      for (let i = 0; i < BAR_COUNT; i++) {
        let sum = 0;
        for (let j = 0; j < step; j++) {
          sum += dataArray[i * step + j];
        }
        const avgVal = sum / step;

        const maxBarHeight = centerY - 5;
        const barHeight = (avgVal / 255) * maxBarHeight;

        // 渐变色：低频绿 -> 高频红
        const hue = 120 - (i / BAR_COUNT) * 120;
        barCtx.strokeStyle = `hsl(${hue}, 100%, 50%)`;
        barCtx.lineWidth = 1.5;

        const x = i * barWidth;
        const w = barWidth - gap;

        // 如果高度太小则不绘制
        if (barHeight <= 0) continue;

        // 计算顶部/底部半圆的半径
        const radius = w / 2;
        const centerX = x + radius;

        // 计算顶部圆弧的圆心 Y 坐标（为了让半圆刚好贴合矩形顶端）
        const topArcY = centerY - barHeight + radius;
        // 计算底部圆弧的圆心 Y 坐标
        const bottomArcY = centerY + barHeight - radius;

        barCtx.beginPath();

        // 从左下角（中心位置）开始
        barCtx.moveTo(x, centerY);
        // 绘制左侧竖线到顶部圆弧起点
        barCtx.lineTo(x, topArcY);

        // 绘制上半部分的半圆 (从左侧到右侧)
        barCtx.arc(centerX, topArcY, radius, Math.PI, 0);

        // 绘制右侧竖线回到中心位置
        barCtx.lineTo(x + w, centerY);

        // 绘制下半部分的半圆 (从右侧回到左侧，完成闭环)
        barCtx.arc(centerX, bottomArcY, radius, 0, Math.PI);

        // 回到原点
        barCtx.lineTo(x, centerY);
        barCtx.stroke();
      }

      requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }
  </script>
</body>
</html>

4.6.6 上下交替描边折线图

  1. 代码示例

    <!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">

<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>上下交替描边频谱图</title>
  <style>
    #db {
      font-size: 20px;
      margin: 10px 0;
      display: inline-block;
    }

    .warn {
      color: #f44;
    }

    canvas {
      background: #000;
      border-radius: 6px;
      display: block;
      margin-top: 10px;
    }

    .audio-content {
      margin-top: 20px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }
  </style>
</head>

<body>
  <canvas id="altCanvas" width="600" height="300"></canvas>
  <div class="audio-content">
    <audio id="audioPlayer" controls src="./audio/01.mp3"></audio>
    <div>当前分贝：<span id="db">0</span> dB</div>
  </div>

  <script>
    const canvas = document.getElementById('altCanvas');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    const dbEl = document.getElementById('db');
    const audioEl = document.getElementById('audioPlayer');

    let audioContext, analyser, source, isReady = false;

    // ========== RMS 相关参数 ==========
    const bufferLength = 2048;
    const AVG_FRAME = 60;
    let dbHistory = [];
    const timeDataArray = new Uint8Array(bufferLength);

    // ========== 频谱相关参数 ==========
    const fftBinCount = 1024;
    const dataArray = new Uint8Array(fftBinCount);
    const BAR_COUNT = 64; // 交替点数量（建议偶数，保证首尾衔接）

    audioEl.onplay = async () => {
      if (!isReady) {
        audioContext = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        analyser = audioContext.createAnalyser();
        analyser.fftSize = bufferLength;
        analyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.85; // 描边线条建议稍高平滑度
        source = audioContext.createMediaElementSource(audioEl);
        source.connect(analyser);
        analyser.connect(audioContext.destination);
        isReady = true;
      }
      if (audioContext.state === 'suspended') await audioContext.resume();
      loop();
    };

    function loop() {
      if (audioEl.paused) return;

      // 1. RMS 分贝计算
      analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(timeDataArray);
      let sumSq = 0;
      for (let v of timeDataArray) {
        const n = (v / 128.0) - 1.0;
        sumSq += n * n;
      }
      const rms = Math.sqrt(sumSq / bufferLength);
      const instantDb = 20 * Math.log10(Math.max(rms, 0.00001));
      dbHistory.push(instantDb);
      if (dbHistory.length > AVG_FRAME) dbHistory.shift();
      const avgDb = dbHistory.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) / dbHistory.length;
      dbEl.textContent = avgDb.toFixed(1);
      dbEl.classList.toggle('warn', avgDb > -20);

      // 2. 获取频域数据
      analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);

      // 3. 绘制交替描边
      ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

      const centerY = canvas.height / 2;
      const step = Math.floor(fftBinCount / BAR_COUNT);
      const sliceWidth = canvas.width / BAR_COUNT;

      // 创建线性渐变（从左到右：绿 -> 黄 -> 红）
      const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, canvas.width, 0);
      grad.addColorStop(0, 'hsl(120, 100%, 50%)');
      grad.addColorStop(0.5, 'hsl(60, 100%, 50%)');
      grad.addColorStop(1, 'hsl(0, 100%, 50%)');

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.strokeStyle = grad;
      ctx.lineWidth = 4; // 描边粗细
      ctx.lineJoin = 'round'; // 让拐角更圆润
      ctx.lineCap = 'round';

      // 预计算所有点，方便做平滑处理
      const points = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < BAR_COUNT; i++) {
        let sum = 0;
        for (let j = 0; j < step; j++) sum += dataArray[i * step + j];
        const avgVal = sum / step;

        const maxH = centerY - 10;
        const h = (avgVal / 255) * maxH;

        // 【核心】交替逻辑：偶数向上，奇数向下
        const y = (i % 2 === 0) ? (centerY - h) : (centerY + h);
        const x = i * sliceWidth + sliceWidth / 2; // 取柱子中心点

        points.push({ x, y });
      }

      // 绘制平滑的交替连线
      if (points.length > 0) {
        ctx.moveTo(points[0].x, points[0].y);

        for (let i = 0; i < points.length - 1; i++) {
          const curr = points[i];
          const next = points[i + 1];

          // 计算控制点，让线条在交替拐角处更圆润
          const cpx = (curr.x + next.x) / 2;
          const cpy1 = curr.y;
          const cpy2 = next.y;

          // 使用贝塞尔曲线连接，形成类似“胶囊描边”的过渡
          ctx.bezierCurveTo(cpx, cpy1, cpx, cpy2, next.x, next.y);
        }
      }

      ctx.stroke();

      // 可选：在中心画一条极淡的参考线
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, centerY);
      ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, centerY);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.stroke();

      requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }
  </script>
</body>

</html>

  <script>
    const barCanvas = document.getElementById('barCanvas');
    const barCtx = barCanvas.getContext('2d');
    const dbEl = document.getElementById('db');
    const audioEl = document.getElementById('audioPlayer');
    let audioContext, analyser, source;
    let isAudioContextReady = false;
    const bufferLength = 2048;
    const fftBinCount = 1024;
    const dataArray = new Uint8Array(fftBinCount);
    const AVG_FRAME = 60;
    let dbHistory = [];
    const BAR_COUNT = 64;

    audioEl.onplay = async () => {
      if (!isAudioContextReady) {
        audioContext = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        analyser = audioContext.createAnalyser();
        analyser.fftSize = bufferLength;
        analyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.8;
        source = audioContext.createMediaElementSource(audioEl);
        source.connect(analyser);
        analyser.connect(audioContext.destination);
        isAudioContextReady = true;
      }
      loop();
    };

    function loop() {
      if (audioEl.paused) return;
      // 1. 计算 RMS 分贝
      analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(dataArray);
      let sumSq = 0;
      for (let v of dataArray) {
        const n = (v / 128.0) - 1.0;
        sumSq += n * n;
      }
      const rms = Math.sqrt(sumSq / bufferLength);
      let instantDb = 20 * Math.log10(Math.max(rms, 0.00001));
      dbHistory.push(instantDb);
      if (dbHistory.length > AVG_FRAME) dbHistory.shift();
      const avgDb = dbHistory.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) / dbHistory.length;
      dbEl.textContent = avgDb.toFixed(1);
      dbEl.classList.toggle('warn', avgDb > -20);

      // 2. 获取频域数据
      analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);
      // 3. 清空画布
      barCtx.fillStyle = '#000';
      barCtx.fillRect(0, 0, barCanvas.width, barCanvas.height);
      const centerY = barCanvas.height / 2;
      const barWidth = barCanvas.width / BAR_COUNT;
      const step = Math.floor(fftBinCount / BAR_COUNT);
      const gap = 0;
      const freqWaveBase = 4;
      const maxBarHeight = centerY - 10;

      for (let i = 0; i < BAR_COUNT; i++) {
        let sum = 0;
        for (let j = 0; j < step; j++) {
          sum += dataArray[i * step + j];
        }
        const avgVal = sum / step;
        const barHeight = (avgVal / 255) * maxBarHeight;

        const x = i * barWidth;
        const w = barWidth - gap;
        const r = w / 2;
        const cx = x + r;
        const hue = 120 - (i / BAR_COUNT) * 120;
        barCtx.strokeStyle = `hsl(${hue}, 100%, 50%)`;
        barCtx.lineWidth = 1.5;

        // ========== 无高度柱：直接绘制直线段 ==========
        if (barHeight <= 0) {
          barCtx.beginPath();
          barCtx.moveTo(x, centerY);
          barCtx.lineTo(x + w, centerY);
          barCtx.stroke();
          continue;
        }

        // ========== 小幅度：椭圆弧，不再用arc半圆 ==========
        if (barHeight < r) {
          barCtx.beginPath();
          // rx：水平半宽固定，ry：垂直高度等于barHeight
          const rx = r;
          const ry = barHeight;
          if (i % 2 === 0) {
            // 偶数向上拱椭圆弧，起点角度 π → 0
            barCtx.ellipse(cx, centerY, rx, ry, 0, Math.PI, 0);
          } else {
            // 奇数向下拱椭圆弧，起点角度 π → 0，逆时针
            barCtx.ellipse(cx, centerY, rx, ry, 0, Math.PI, 0, true);
          }
          barCtx.stroke();
          continue;
        }

        // ========== 大幅度：正常胶囊 ==========
        if (i % 2 === 0) {
          // 偶数柱朝上生长
          const bottomY = centerY;
          const topY = centerY - barHeight;
          barCtx.beginPath();
          barCtx.moveTo(x, bottomY);
          barCtx.lineTo(x, topY + r);
          barCtx.arc(cx, topY + r, r, Math.PI, 0);
          barCtx.lineTo(x + w, bottomY);
          barCtx.stroke();
        } else {
          // 奇数柱朝下生长
          const topY = centerY;
          const bottomY = centerY + barHeight;
          barCtx.beginPath();
          barCtx.moveTo(x, topY);
          barCtx.lineTo(x, bottomY - r);
          barCtx.arc(cx, bottomY - r, r, Math.PI,0,true );
          barCtx.lineTo(x + w, topY);
          barCtx.stroke();
        }
      }
      requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }
  </script>

4.6.8 外环折线图

  1. 代码示例

    <!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">

<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>环形折线图</title>
  <style>
    #db {
      font-size: 20px;
      margin: 10px 0;
      display: inline-block;
    }

    .warn {
      color: #f44;
    }

    canvas {
      background: #000;
      display: block;
      margin-top: 10px;
    }

    .audio-content {
      margin-top: 20px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }
  </style>
</head>

<body>
  <canvas id="lineCanvas" width="400" height="400"></canvas>
  <div class="audio-content">
    <audio id="audioPlayer" controls src="./audio/01.mp3"></audio>
    <div>当前分贝：<span id="db">0</span> dB</div>
  </div>

  <script>
    const canvas = document.getElementById('lineCanvas');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    const dbEl = document.getElementById('db');
    const audioEl = document.getElementById('audioPlayer');

    let audioContext, analyser, source, isReady = false;

    // RMS 相关参数 
    const bufferLength = 2048;
    const AVG_FRAME = 60;
    let dbHistory = [];

    // 频谱折线相关参数 
    const fftBinCount = 1024;
    const dataArray = new Uint8Array(fftBinCount); // 仅用于频域数据
    const timeDataArray = new Uint8Array(bufferLength); // 独立数组用于RMS，避免与频域数据互相	覆盖
    const POINT_COUNT = 128;
    const BASE_RADIUS = 80;
    const MAX_AMPLITUDE = 100;

    audioEl.onplay = async () => {
      if (!isReady) {
        audioContext = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        analyser = audioContext.createAnalyser();
        analyser.fftSize = bufferLength;
        analyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.85;
        source = audioContext.createMediaElementSource(audioEl);
        source.connect(analyser);
        analyser.connect(audioContext.destination);
        isReady = true;
      }
      if (audioContext.state === 'suspended') await audioContext.resume();
      loop();
    };

    function loop() {
      if (audioEl.paused) return;

      // 1. RMS 分贝计算（完整保留）
      analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(timeDataArray);
      let sumSq = 0;
      for (let v of timeDataArray) {
        const n = (v / 128.0) - 1.0;
        sumSq += n * n;
      }
      const rms = Math.sqrt(sumSq / bufferLength);
      const instantDb = 20 * Math.log10(Math.max(rms, 0.00001));

      dbHistory.push(instantDb);
      if (dbHistory.length > AVG_FRAME) dbHistory.shift();
      const avgDb = dbHistory.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) / dbHistory.length;

      dbEl.textContent = avgDb.toFixed(1);
      dbEl.classList.toggle('warn', avgDb > -20);


      // 2. 获取频域数据并绘制环形折线

      analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);

      const cx = canvas.width / 2;
      const cy = canvas.height / 2;

      ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

      // 基准参考圆
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, BASE_RADIUS, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.stroke();

      // 锥形渐变
      const grad = ctx.createConicGradient(-Math.PI / 2, cx, cy);
      grad.addColorStop(0, 'hsl(120, 100%, 50%)');  // 起点=绿色（12点钟）
      grad.addColorStop(0.25, 'hsl(60, 100%, 50%)');   // 黄色（3点钟方向）
      grad.addColorStop(0.5, 'hsl(0, 100%, 50%)');    // 红色（6点钟方向）
      grad.addColorStop(0.75, 'hsl(60, 100%, 50%)');   // 黄色（9点钟方向）
      grad.addColorStop(1, 'hsl(120, 100%, 50%)');  // 终点=绿色（回到12点钟）

      // 绘制闭合折线
      const step = Math.floor(fftBinCount / POINT_COUNT);
      const angleStep = (Math.PI * 2) / POINT_COUNT;
      const startOffset = -Math.PI / 2;

      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let i = 0; i <= POINT_COUNT; i++) {
        const idx = i % POINT_COUNT;

        let sum = 0;
        for (let j = 0; j < step; j++) sum += dataArray[idx * step + j];
        const avgVal = sum / step;
        const r = BASE_RADIUS + (avgVal / 255) * MAX_AMPLITUDE;

        const angle = startOffset + idx * angleStep;
        const x = cx + r * Math.cos(angle);
        const y = cy + r * Math.sin(angle);

        if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
        else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      }
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.strokeStyle = grad;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.stroke();

      // 半透明填充增强视觉体量
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.1;
      ctx.fillStyle = grad;
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1.0;

      requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }
  </script>
</body>

</html>

  <script>
    const canvas = document.getElementById('lineCanvas');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    const dbEl = document.getElementById('db');
    const audioEl = document.getElementById('audioPlayer');

    let audioContext, analyser, source, isReady = false;

    const timeDataArray = new Uint8Array(bufferLength); // 专供 RMS 使用

    // 频谱折线相关参数 
    const fftBinCount = 1024;
    const dataArray = new Uint8Array(fftBinCount);      // 专供频谱使用
    const POINT_COUNT = 128;
    const OUTER_RADIUS = 180;      // 折线的外边界基准
    const MAX_AMPLITUDE = 140;     // 折线向内延伸的最大长度

    audioEl.onplay = async () => {
      if (!isReady) {
        audioContext = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        analyser = audioContext.createAnalyser();
        analyser.fftSize = bufferLength;
        analyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.85; // 折线图建议稍高平滑度，避免线条抖动
        source = audioContext.createMediaElementSource(audioEl);
        source.connect(analyser);
        analyser.connect(audioContext.destination);
        isReady = true;
      }
      if (audioContext.state === 'suspended') await audioContext.resume();
      loop();
    };

    function loop() {
      if (audioEl.paused) return;

      // 1. RMS 分贝计算（完整保留）
      analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(timeDataArray);
      let sumSq = 0;
      for (let v of timeDataArray) {
        const n = (v / 128.0) - 1.0;
        sumSq += n * n;
      }
      const rms = Math.sqrt(sumSq / bufferLength);
      const instantDb = 20 * Math.log10(Math.max(rms, 0.00001));

      dbHistory.push(instantDb);
      if (dbHistory.length > AVG_FRAME) dbHistory.shift();
      const avgDb = dbHistory.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) / dbHistory.length;

      dbEl.textContent = avgDb.toFixed(1);
      dbEl.classList.toggle('warn', avgDb > -20);

      // 2. 获取频域数据并绘制内环折线
      analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);

      const cx = canvas.width / 2;
      const cy = canvas.height / 2;

      // 清空画布
      ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

      // 绘制外环基准线（作为视觉锚点）
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, OUTER_RADIUS, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.stroke();

      // 创建锥形渐变（绿 -> 黄 -> 红 -> 黄 -> 绿，无缝衔接）
      const grad = ctx.createConicGradient(-Math.PI / 2, cx, cy);
      grad.addColorStop(0, 'hsl(120, 100%, 50%)');
      grad.addColorStop(0.25, 'hsl(60, 100%, 50%)');
      grad.addColorStop(0.5, 'hsl(0, 100%, 50%)');
      grad.addColorStop(0.75, 'hsl(60, 100%, 50%)');
      grad.addColorStop(1, 'hsl(120, 100%, 50%)');

      // 【核心】收集所有点并绘制闭合折线
      const step = Math.floor(fftBinCount / POINT_COUNT);
      const angleStep = (Math.PI * 2) / POINT_COUNT;
      const startOffset = -Math.PI / 2; // 从正上方开始

      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let i = 0; i <= POINT_COUNT; i++) {
        const idx = i % POINT_COUNT; // 关键：i=POINT_COUNT 时回到 idx=0，实现完美闭合

        let sum = 0;
        for (let j = 0; j < step; j++) sum += dataArray[idx * step + j];
        const avgVal = sum / step;

        // 【内环核心】计算向内延伸的半径
        const barLength = (avgVal / 255) * MAX_AMPLITUDE;
        const r = OUTER_RADIUS - barLength;
        // 防止穿过圆心，设置最小内半径
        const safeR = Math.max(r, 10);

        const angle = startOffset + idx * angleStep;
        const x = cx + safeR * Math.cos(angle);
        const y = cy + safeR * Math.sin(angle);

        if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
        else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      }

      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.strokeStyle = grad;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.stroke();

      // 可选：给折线内部加一层半透明填充，增强视觉体量感
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.1;
      ctx.fillStyle = grad;
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1.0;

      requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }
  </script>
</body>

</html>

4.6.10 环形胶囊图

  1. 代码示例

    <!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>环形镜像胶囊频谱</title>
  <style>
    #db {
      font-size: 20px;
      margin: 10px 0;
      display: inline-block;
    }
    .warn { color: #f44; }
    canvas {
      background: #000;
      display: block;
      margin-top: 10px;
    }
    .audio-content {
      margin-top: 20px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <canvas id="barCanvas" width="500" height="500"></canvas>
  <div class="audio-content">
    <audio id="audioPlayer" controls src="./audio/01.mp3"></audio>
    <div>当前分贝：<span id="db">0</span> dB</div>
  </div>
  <script>
    const barCanvas = document.getElementById('barCanvas');
    const barCtx = barCanvas.getContext('2d');
    const dbEl = document.getElementById('db');
    const audioEl = document.getElementById('audioPlayer');

    let audioContext, analyser, source;
    let isAudioContextReady = false;

    const bufferLength = 2048;
    const fftBinCount = 1024;
    const dataArray = new Uint8Array(fftBinCount);
    const AVG_FRAME = 60;
    let dbHistory = [];

    const BAR_COUNT = 72;            // 柱子数量（越多越细腻）
    const BASE_R = 180;              // 基准半径（镜像中线）
    const MAX_OFFSET = 70;           // 最大径向偏移（内外各这么多）
    const CAPSULE_WIDTH = 6;         // 胶囊宽度（切向）

    audioEl.onplay = async () => {
      if (!isAudioContextReady) {
        audioContext = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        analyser = audioContext.createAnalyser();
        analyser.fftSize = bufferLength;
        analyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.8;
        source = audioContext.createMediaElementSource(audioEl);
        source.connect(analyser);
        analyser.connect(audioContext.destination);
        isAudioContextReady = true;
      }
      if (audioContext.state === 'suspended') await audioContext.resume();
      loop();
    };

    function loop() {
      if (audioEl.paused) return;

      // ---- 计算分贝（用于显示） ----
      analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(dataArray);
      let sumSq = 0;
      for (let v of dataArray) {
        const n = (v / 128.0) - 1.0;
        sumSq += n * n;
      }
      const rms = Math.sqrt(sumSq / bufferLength);
      let instantDb = 20 * Math.log10(Math.max(rms, 0.00001));
      dbHistory.push(instantDb);
      if (dbHistory.length > AVG_FRAME) dbHistory.shift();
      const avgDb = dbHistory.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) / dbHistory.length;
      dbEl.textContent = avgDb.toFixed(1);
      dbEl.classList.toggle('warn', avgDb > -20);

      // ---- 获取频域数据 ----
      analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);

      const centerX = barCanvas.width / 2;
      const centerY = barCanvas.height / 2;

      // ---- 清空画布 ----
      barCtx.fillStyle = '#000';
      barCtx.fillRect(0, 0, barCanvas.width, barCanvas.height);

      // ---- 绘制参考圆（半透明） ----
      barCtx.beginPath();
      barCtx.arc(centerX, centerY, BASE_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      barCtx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)';
      barCtx.lineWidth = 1;
      barCtx.stroke();

      const step = Math.floor(fftBinCount / BAR_COUNT);
      const angleStep = (Math.PI * 2) / BAR_COUNT;
      const startOffset = -Math.PI / 2; // 从顶部开始

      for (let i = 0; i < BAR_COUNT; i++) {
        // 计算该柱子的平均幅度
        let sum = 0;
        for (let j = 0; j < step; j++) {
          sum += dataArray[i * step + j];
        }
        const avgVal = sum / step;
        const offset = (avgVal / 255) * MAX_OFFSET; // 0 ~ MAX_OFFSET

        // 当前角度
        const angle = startOffset + i * angleStep;

        // 颜色（低音绿 → 高音红）
        const hue = 120 - (i / BAR_COUNT) * 120;
        barCtx.strokeStyle = `hsl(${hue}, 100%, 55%)`;
        barCtx.lineWidth = 1.8;

        // ---- 核心：绘制径向胶囊 ----
        barCtx.save();
        barCtx.translate(centerX, centerY);
        barCtx.rotate(angle);

        // 局部坐标系：x 轴指向径向向外
        const halfLen = offset;          // 单侧长度
        const halfW = CAPSULE_WIDTH / 2; // 半宽度

        if (halfLen < 0.5) {
          // 幅度极小 → 画一个小点或短横线
          barCtx.beginPath();
          barCtx.moveTo(BASE_R - 1, 0);
          barCtx.lineTo(BASE_R + 1, 0);
          barCtx.stroke();
        } else {
          // 绘制完整胶囊：矩形 + 两个半圆
          barCtx.beginPath();
          // 上边直线（从内到外）
          barCtx.moveTo(BASE_R - halfLen, -halfW);
          barCtx.lineTo(BASE_R + halfLen, -halfW);
          // 右端半圆（顺时针从 -PI/2 到 PI/2，画上半圆）
          barCtx.arc(BASE_R + halfLen, 0, halfW, -Math.PI / 2, Math.PI / 2);
          // 下边直线（从外到内）
          barCtx.lineTo(BASE_R - halfLen, halfW);
          // 左端半圆（逆时针从 PI/2 到 -PI/2，画上半圆）
          barCtx.arc(BASE_R - halfLen, 0, halfW, Math.PI / 2, -Math.PI / 2);
          barCtx.closePath();
          barCtx.stroke();
        }

        barCtx.restore();
      }

      // ---- 中心黑色遮罩 ----
      barCtx.beginPath();
      barCtx.arc(centerX, centerY, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      barCtx.fillStyle = '#000';
      barCtx.fill();

      requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }
  </script>
</body>
</html>

    <!DOCTYPE html>

<head>

  <style>
    #db {

    .warn {

    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <canvas id="lineCanvas" width="500" height="500"></canvas>
  <div class="audio-content">
    <audio id="audioPlayer" controls src="./audio/01.mp3">
    <div>当前分贝：<span id="db">0</span> dB</div>
  </div>
  <script>
    const canvas = document.getElementById('lineCanvas');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    const dbEl = document.getElementById('db');
    const audioEl = document.getElementById('audioPlayer');
    let audioContext, analyser, source, isReady = false;

    const bufferLength = 2048;
    const AVG_FRAME = 60;
    let dbHistory = [];
    const timeDataArray = new Uint8Array(bufferLength);

    const fftBinCount = 1024;
    const dataArray = new Uint8Array(fftBinCount);
    const POINT_COUNT = 128;

    const BASE_RADIUS = 160;      // 镜像中线基准半径
    const MAX_AMPLITUDE = 90;     // 向外/向内最大偏移幅度

    audioEl.onplay = async () => {
      if (!isReady) {
        audioContext = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        analyser = audioContext.createAnalyser();
        analyser.fftSize = bufferLength;
        analyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.85;
        source = audioContext.createMediaElementSource(audioEl);
        source.connect(analyser);
        analyser.connect(audioContext.destination);
        isReady = true;
      }
      if (audioContext.state === 'suspended') await audioContext.resume();
      loop();
    };

    function loop() {
      if (audioEl.paused) return;

      // RMS分贝计算
      analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(timeDataArray);
      let sumSq = 0;
      for (let v of timeDataArray) {
        const n = (v / 128.0) - 1.0;
        sumSq += n * n;
      }
      const rms = Math.sqrt(sumSq / bufferLength);
      const instantDb = 20 * Math.log10(Math.max(rms, 0.00001));
      dbHistory.push(instantDb);
      if (dbHistory.length > AVG_FRAME) dbHistory.shift();
      const avgDb = dbHistory.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) / dbHistory.length;
      dbEl.textContent = avgDb.toFixed(1);
      dbEl.classList.toggle('warn', avgDb > -20);

      analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);
      const cx = canvas.width / 2;
      const cy = canvas.height / 2;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

      // 中间基准参考圈
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, BASE_RADIUS, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.stroke();

      // 锥形渐变 绿‑黄‑红‑黄‑绿
      const grad = ctx.createConicGradient(-Math.PI / 2, cx, cy);
      grad.addColorStop(0, 'hsl(120, 100%, 50%)');
      grad.addColorStop(0.25, 'hsl(60, 100%, 50%)');
      grad.addColorStop(0.5, 'hsl(0, 100%, 50%)');
      grad.addColorStop(0.75, 'hsl(60, 100%, 50%)');
      grad.addColorStop(1, 'hsl(120, 100%, 50%)');

      const step = Math.floor(fftBinCount / POINT_COUNT);
      const angleStep = (Math.PI * 2) / POINT_COUNT;
      const startOffset = -Math.PI / 2;

      // 预先计算全部点：外点数组、内点数组
      const outerPoints = [];
      const innerPoints = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < POINT_COUNT; i++) {
        let sum = 0;
        for (let j = 0; j < step; j++) sum += dataArray[i * step + j];
        const avgVal = sum / step;
        const offset = (avgVal / 255) * MAX_AMPLITUDE;

        const rOut = BASE_RADIUS + offset;
        const rIn = Math.max(BASE_RADIUS - offset, 10);

        const angle = startOffset + i * angleStep;
        outerPoints.push({
          x: cx + rOut * Math.cos(angle),
          y: cy + rOut * Math.sin(angle)
        });
        innerPoints.push({
          x: cx + rIn * Math.cos(angle),
          y: cy + rIn * Math.sin(angle)
        });
      }

      // 绘制闭合路径：先沿外圈顺时针，再沿内圈逆时针回来闭合
      ctx.beginPath();
      // 外圈正向
      ctx.moveTo(outerPoints[0].x, outerPoints[0].y);
      for (let i = 1; i < POINT_COUNT; i++) {
        ctx.lineTo(outerPoints[i].x, outerPoints[i].y);
      }
      // 连接到内圈最后一个点，反向遍历内圈
      ctx.lineTo(innerPoints[POINT_COUNT - 1].x, innerPoints[POINT_COUNT - 1].y);
      for (let i = POINT_COUNT - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
        ctx.lineTo(innerPoints[i].x, innerPoints[i].y);
      }
      ctx.closePath();

      ctx.strokeStyle = grad;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.stroke();

      // 半透明填充环形带内部
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.12;
      ctx.fillStyle = grad;
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1.0;

      requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }
  </script>
</body>
</html>

  1. 代码示例

    <!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">

<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>内外交替折线图 (带RMS分贝)</title>
  <style>
    #db {
      font-size: 20px;
      margin: 10px 0;
      display: inline-block;
    }

      color: #f44;
    }

<body>
  <canvas id="altLineCanvas" width="500" height="500"></canvas>
  <div class="audio-content">
    <audio id="audioPlayer" controls src="./audio/01.mp3"></audio>
    <div>当前分贝：<span id="db">0</span> dB</div>
  </div>

  <script>
    const canvas = document.getElementById('altLineCanvas');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    const dbEl = document.getElementById('db');
    const audioEl = document.getElementById('audioPlayer');

    let audioContext, analyser, source, isReady = false;

    // ========== RMS 相关参数 ==========
    const bufferLength = 2048;
    const AVG_FRAME = 60;
    let dbHistory = [];
    const timeDataArray = new Uint8Array(bufferLength); // 专供 RMS 使用

    // ========== 频谱折线相关参数 ==========
    const fftBinCount = 1024;
    const dataArray = new Uint8Array(fftBinCount);      // 专供频谱使用
    const POINT_COUNT = 64; // 建议保持偶数，确保内外环交替完美闭合
    const OUTER_RADIUS = 180; // 外环基准半径
    const INNER_RADIUS = 80;  // 内环基准半径
    const MAX_AMPLITUDE = 60; // 振幅向外/内延伸的最大长度

    audioEl.onplay = async () => {
      if (!isReady) {
        audioContext = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        analyser = audioContext.createAnalyser();
        analyser.fftSize = bufferLength;
        analyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.85;
        source = audioContext.createMediaElementSource(audioEl);
        source.connect(analyser);
        analyser.connect(audioContext.destination);
        isReady = true;
      }
      if (audioContext.state === 'suspended') await audioContext.resume();
      loop();
    };

    function loop() {
      if (audioEl.paused) return;


      // 1. RMS 分贝计算（完整保留）

      analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(timeDataArray);
      let sumSq = 0;
      for (let v of timeDataArray) {
        const n = (v / 128.0) - 1.0;
        sumSq += n * n;
      }
      const rms = Math.sqrt(sumSq / bufferLength);
      const instantDb = 20 * Math.log10(Math.max(rms, 0.00001));

      dbHistory.push(instantDb);
      if (dbHistory.length > AVG_FRAME) dbHistory.shift();
      const avgDb = dbHistory.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) / dbHistory.length;

      dbEl.textContent = avgDb.toFixed(1);
      dbEl.classList.toggle('warn', avgDb > -20);


      // 2. 获取频域数据并绘制交替折线

      analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);

      const cx = canvas.width / 2;
      const cy = canvas.height / 2;

      // 清空画布
      ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

      // 绘制内外环基准线（作为视觉参考）
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, OUTER_RADIUS, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.stroke();

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, INNER_RADIUS, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();

      // 创建锥形渐变（绿 -> 黄 -> 红 -> 黄 -> 绿，无缝衔接）
      const grad = ctx.createConicGradient(-Math.PI / 2, cx, cy);
      grad.addColorStop(0, 'hsl(120, 100%, 50%)');
      grad.addColorStop(0.25, 'hsl(60, 100%, 50%)');
      grad.addColorStop(0.5, 'hsl(0, 100%, 50%)');
      grad.addColorStop(0.75, 'hsl(60, 100%, 50%)');
      grad.addColorStop(1, 'hsl(120, 100%, 50%)');

      // 【核心】收集所有点并绘制交替折线
      const step = Math.floor(fftBinCount / POINT_COUNT);
      const angleStep = (Math.PI * 2) / POINT_COUNT;
      const startOffset = -Math.PI / 2; // 从正上方开始

      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let i = 0; i <= POINT_COUNT; i++) {
        const idx = i % POINT_COUNT;

        let sum = 0;
        for (let j = 0; j < step; j++) sum += dataArray[idx * step + j];
        const avgVal = sum / step;
        const amplitude = (avgVal / 255) * MAX_AMPLITUDE;

        // 【核心逻辑】根据索引奇偶性决定落在外环还是内环
        let currentRadius;
        if (i % 2 === 0) {
          // 偶数点：落在外环，向外延伸
          currentRadius = OUTER_RADIUS + amplitude;
        } else {
          // 奇数点：落在内环，向内延伸
          currentRadius = INNER_RADIUS - amplitude;
          // 防止穿过圆心
          currentRadius = Math.max(currentRadius, 10);
        }

        const angle = startOffset + idx * angleStep;
        const x = cx + currentRadius * Math.cos(angle);
        const y = cy + currentRadius * Math.sin(angle);

        if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
        else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      }

      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.strokeStyle = grad;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.stroke();

      // 给折线内部加一层半透明填充，增强齿轮/星芒的体量感
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.15;
      ctx.fillStyle = grad;
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1.0;

      requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }
  </script>
</body>

</html>
