4.6.14 内外交叠连接三角形

  1. 代码示例

    <!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>环形交替尖头频谱</title>
  <style>
    #db {
      font-size: 20px;
      margin: 10px 0;
      display: inline-block;
    }
    .warn {
      color: #f44;
    }
    canvas {
      background: #000;
      display: block;
      margin-top: 10px;
    }
    .audio-content {
      margin-top: 20px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <canvas id="barCanvas" width="500" height="500"></canvas>
  <div class="audio-content">
    <audio id="audioPlayer" controls src="./audio/01.mp3"></audio>
    <div>当前分贝：<span id="db">0</span> dB</div>
  </div>
  <script>
    const barCanvas = document.getElementById('barCanvas');
    const barCtx = barCanvas.getContext('2d');
    const dbEl = document.getElementById('db');
    const audioEl = document.getElementById('audioPlayer');
    let audioContext, analyser, source;
    let isAudioContextReady = false;

    const bufferLength = 2048;
    const fftBinCount = 1024;
    const dataArray = new Uint8Array(fftBinCount);
    const AVG_FRAME = 60;
    let dbHistory = [];

    const BAR_COUNT = 64;
    const BASE_R = 160;
    const MAX_OFFSET = 90;

    audioEl.onplay = async () => {
      if (!isAudioContextReady) {
        audioContext = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        analyser = audioContext.createAnalyser();
        analyser.fftSize = bufferLength;
        analyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.8;
        source = audioContext.createMediaElementSource(audioEl);
        source.connect(analyser);
        analyser.connect(audioContext.destination);
        isAudioContextReady = true;
      }
      if (audioContext.state === 'suspended') await audioContext.resume();
      loop();
    };

    function loop() {
      if (audioEl.paused) return;

      analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(dataArray);
      let sumSq = 0;
      for (let v of dataArray) {
        const n = (v / 128.0) - 1.0;
        sumSq += n * n;
      }
      const rms = Math.sqrt(sumSq / bufferLength);
      let instantDb = 20 * Math.log10(Math.max(rms, 0.00001));
      dbHistory.push(instantDb);
      if (dbHistory.length > AVG_FRAME) dbHistory.shift();
      const avgDb = dbHistory.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) / dbHistory.length;
      dbEl.textContent = avgDb.toFixed(1);
      dbEl.classList.toggle('warn', avgDb > -20);

      analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);

      const centerX = barCanvas.width / 2;
      const centerY = barCanvas.height / 2;
      barCtx.fillStyle = '#000';
      barCtx.fillRect(0, 0, barCanvas.width, barCanvas.height);

      // 绘制基准中线圆环
      barCtx.beginPath();
      barCtx.arc(centerX, centerY, BASE_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      barCtx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)';
      barCtx.lineWidth = 1;
      barCtx.stroke();

      const step = Math.floor(fftBinCount / BAR_COUNT);
      const angleStep = (Math.PI * 2) / BAR_COUNT;
      const startOffset = -Math.PI / 2;

      for (let i = 0; i < BAR_COUNT; i++) {
        let sum = 0;
        for (let j = 0; j < step; j++) {
          sum += dataArray[i * step + j];
        }
        const avgVal = sum / step;
        const offset = (avgVal / 255) * MAX_OFFSET;

        const hue = 120 - (i / BAR_COUNT) * 120;
        barCtx.strokeStyle = `hsl(${hue}, 100%, 50%)`;
        barCtx.lineWidth = 1.5;

        const a0 = startOffset + i * angleStep;
        const a1 = startOffset + (i + 1) * angleStep;
        const midAngle = (a0 + a1) / 2;

        // 振幅为0：只画基准圆弧小段
        if (offset <= 0.1) {
          barCtx.beginPath();
          barCtx.arc(centerX, centerY, BASE_R, a0, a1);
          barCtx.stroke();
          continue;
        }

        barCtx.beginPath();
        // 起点：基准圆上的 a0 点
        barCtx.moveTo(
          centerX + BASE_R * Math.cos(a0),
          centerY + BASE_R * Math.sin(a0)
        );

        if (i % 2 === 0) {
          // === 偶数：向外尖头凸起 ===
          const rTip = BASE_R + offset;

          // 计算向外的尖头顶点坐标
          const tipX = centerX + rTip * Math.cos(midAngle);
          const tipY = centerY + rTip * Math.sin(midAngle);

          // 画第一条直线到尖头顶点
          barCtx.lineTo(tipX, tipY);

          // 画第二条直线回到 a1 基准点
          barCtx.lineTo(
            centerX + BASE_R * Math.cos(a1), 
            centerY + BASE_R * Math.sin(a1)
          );

        } else {
          // === 奇数：向内尖头凹陷 ===
          const rTip = Math.max(BASE_R - offset, 20);

          // 计算向内的尖头顶点坐标
          const tipX = centerX + rTip * Math.cos(midAngle);
          const tipY = centerY + rTip * Math.sin(midAngle);

          // 画第一条直线到内尖顶点
          barCtx.lineTo(tipX, tipY);

          // 画第二条直线回到 a1 基准点
          barCtx.lineTo(
            centerX + BASE_R * Math.cos(a1), 
            centerY + BASE_R * Math.sin(a1)
          );
        }
        barCtx.stroke();
      }

      requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }
  </script>
</body>
</html>

      loop();

    function loop() {

      analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(dataArray);
      let sumSq = 0;
      for (let v of dataArray) {
        const n = (v / 128.0) - 1.0;

      }

          const p1y = centerY + BASE_R * Math.sin(a1);

          const q1x = centerX + rMid * Math.cos(a1);

          barCtx.lineTo(q1x, q1y);

      }

          barCtx.lineTo(

            centerY + BASE_R * Math.sin(a1)

      margin-top: 10px;
    }
    .audio-content {
      margin-top: 20px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <canvas id="barCanvas" width="500" height="500"></canvas>
  <div class="audio-content">
    <audio id="audioPlayer" controls src="./audio/01.mp3">
    <div>当前分贝：<span id="db">0</span> dB</div>
  </div>
  <script>
    const barCanvas = document.getElementById('barCanvas');
    const barCtx = barCanvas.getContext('2d');
    const dbEl = document.getElementById('db');
    const audioEl = document.getElementById('audioPlayer');
    let audioContext, analyser, source;
    let isAudioContextReady = false;

    const bufferLength = 2048;
    const fftBinCount = 1024;
    const dataArray = new Uint8Array(fftBinCount);
    const AVG_FRAME = 60;
    let dbHistory = [];

    const BAR_COUNT = 64;
    const BASE_R = 160;         // 圆环基准中线半径
    const MAX_OFFSET = 90;     // 胶囊最大径向偏移

    audioEl.onplay = async () => {
      if (!isAudioContextReady) {
        audioContext = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        analyser = audioContext.createAnalyser();
        analyser.fftSize = bufferLength;
        analyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.8;
        source = audioContext.createMediaElementSource(audioEl);
        source.connect(analyser);
        analyser.connect(audioContext.destination);
        isAudioContextReady = true;
      }
      if (audioContext.state === 'suspended') await audioContext.resume();
      loop();
    };

    function loop() {
      if (audioEl.paused) return;

      analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(dataArray);
      let sumSq = 0;
      for (let v of dataArray) {
        const n = (v / 128.0) - 1.0;
        sumSq += n * n;
      }
      const rms = Math.sqrt(sumSq / bufferLength);
      let instantDb = 20 * Math.log10(Math.max(rms, 0.00001));
      dbHistory.push(instantDb);
      if (dbHistory.length > AVG_FRAME) dbHistory.shift();
      const avgDb = dbHistory.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) / dbHistory.length;
      dbEl.textContent = avgDb.toFixed(1);
      dbEl.classList.toggle('warn', avgDb > -20);

      analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);

      const centerX = barCanvas.width / 2;
      const centerY = barCanvas.height / 2;
      barCtx.fillStyle = '#000';
      barCtx.fillRect(0, 0, barCanvas.width, barCanvas.height);

      // 绘制基准中线圆环
      barCtx.beginPath();
      barCtx.arc(centerX, centerY, BASE_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      barCtx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)';
      barCtx.lineWidth = 1;
      barCtx.stroke();

      const step = Math.floor(fftBinCount / BAR_COUNT);
      const angleStep = (Math.PI * 2) / BAR_COUNT;
      const startOffset = -Math.PI / 2;

        for (let i = 0; i < BAR_COUNT; i++) {
        let sum = 0;
        for (let j = 0; j < step; j++) {
          sum += dataArray[i * step + j];
        }
        const avgVal = sum / step;
        const offset = (avgVal / 255) * MAX_OFFSET;

        const hue = 120 - (i / BAR_COUNT) * 120;
        barCtx.strokeStyle = `hsl(${hue}, 100%, 50%)`;
        barCtx.lineWidth = 1.5;

        const a0 = startOffset + i * angleStep;
        const a1 = startOffset + (i + 1) * angleStep;
        const midAngle = (a0 + a1) / 2;
        const halfAng = angleStep / 2;

        // 振幅为0：只画基准圆弧小段
        if (offset <= 0.1) {
          barCtx.beginPath();
          barCtx.arc(centerX, centerY, BASE_R, a0, a1);
          barCtx.stroke();
          continue;
        }

        barCtx.beginPath();
        // 起点：基准圆上的 a0 点
        barCtx.moveTo(
          centerX + BASE_R * Math.cos(a0),
          centerY + BASE_R * Math.sin(a0)
        );

        if (i % 2 === 0) {
          // === 偶数：向外凸起胶囊 ===
          const rTip = BASE_R + offset; // 胶囊顶端所在半径
          // 动态计算：使圆弧与两侧径向线相切
          const capsuleR = rTip * Math.tan(halfAng);
          // 圆心到原点的距离（比 rTip 更远，以保证相切）
          const centerDist = rTip / Math.cos(halfAng);

          const px = centerX + centerDist * Math.cos(midAngle);
          const py = centerY + centerDist * Math.sin(midAngle);

          // 径向线延伸到胶囊根部（与圆弧相切的点）
          barCtx.lineTo(px - capsuleR * Math.cos(a0 + Math.PI / 2), 
                        py - capsuleR * Math.sin(a0 + Math.PI / 2));


          // 绘制胶囊头部圆弧（顺时针）
          // 起始角 = a0 + PI/2 (右侧切线法向)
          // 结束角 = a1 - PI/2 (左侧切线法向)
          barCtx.arc(px, py, capsuleR, a0 - Math.PI / 2, a1 + Math.PI / 2);

          // 从另一侧切点回到基准圆 a1
          barCtx.lineTo(centerX + BASE_R * Math.cos(a1), 
                        centerY + BASE_R * Math.sin(a1));

        } else {
          // === 奇数：向内凹陷胶囊 ===
          const rTip = Math.max(BASE_R - offset, 20);
          const capsuleR = rTip * Math.tan(halfAng);
          const centerDist = rTip / Math.cos(halfAng);

          const px = centerX + centerDist * Math.cos(midAngle);
          const py = centerY + centerDist * Math.sin(midAngle);

          barCtx.lineTo(px + capsuleR * Math.cos(a0 - Math.PI / 2), 
                        py + capsuleR * Math.sin(a0 - Math.PI / 2));

          // 内凹圆弧（逆时针）
          barCtx.arc(px, py, capsuleR, a0 - Math.PI / 2, a1 + Math.PI / 2, true);

          barCtx.lineTo(centerX + BASE_R * Math.cos(a1), 
                        centerY + BASE_R * Math.sin(a1));
        }
        barCtx.stroke();
      }

      requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }
  </script>
</body>
</html>
